Hi Anna
thanks for sending these options. Quick note on timezones: the US daylight savings changeover happens the weekend of Nov 1 (clocks fall back in North America), while Australia is already on DST (UTC+11). That sometimes shifts the wall-clock overlap we expect.

To confirm we have the right conversion: when you say "10:00 AM AEDT (UTC+11) on Nov 3", that corresponds to 6:00 PM PT on Nov 2 (or 9:00 PM ET on Nov 2) *after* the US changes clocks. I want to make sure we don't accidentally show up an hour early/late.

Who from our side should attend: I'll lead the product demo, and Rafael will join as SE for technical Q&A. Jordan can help on scheduling and follow-ups.

Would you be open to one of these options (I included US/EU friendly slots):
- Tue Nov 3 8:00 AM PT / Wed Nov 4 3:00 AM AEDT (less ideal for AU)
- Tue Nov 3 5:00 PM PT / Wed Nov 4 1:00 PM AEDT (your original window, good overlap)
- Wed Nov 4 8:00 AM PT / Thu Nov 5 1:00 AM AEDT (late for AU)

If you prefer, Rafael and I can suggest two specific 45-minute slots in AEDT and we'll send a calendar invite with both so you can pick. Attached a quick timezone table showing the Nov 1 changeover impact.

Marissa Cole
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: timezone-changeover-table.xlsx (spreadsheet, 12KB)]
